question: does winding number = zero modes on the lattice (discrete index theorem)?
conclusion: winding (topological index) = zero modes (analytical index) holds directly on the discrete lattice, WITHOUT taking the continuum limit. Topological charge (winding) is a PURE DISCRETE invariant - it does NOT need to break the 'discrete->continuous' wall. The two halves of the wall are ASYMMETRIC: topology (discrete, complete) vs smoothness (needs continuum limit).
